mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (over 12 months of data).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), persistent inflation pressures lead to delayed monetary policy responses, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in nonfarm payrolls signals a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds the 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production signals a manufacturing sector slowdown, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1.0% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP growth and housing starts indicate a broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < -0.5% and HOUST MoM decline > 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ growth < -0.5% and HOUST MoM decline > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes where industrial production is below the 2017 base (INDPRO < 100), a further decline in production signals deepening economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and INDPRO declines from prior month.
